description: This file defines a SecureStorage class that provides secure storage of sensitive data, such as SSH passwords, using AndroidX Security Crypto components with encrypted shared preferences. It implements a singleton pattern for instance management and offers methods to get, set, and clear the stored password.

classes.name: SecureStorage
classes.description: A helper class responsible for securely storing sensitive data like SSH passwords using encrypted shared preferences and a master key.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the stored password or null if none is set.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Stores or updates the password securely.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all secrets stored within this storage, including the password.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SecureStorage, scoped to the application context.
